description: This file defines an interface for a device type in the Zend Framework's HTTP UserAgent package, specifying methods for device features, browser info, and capabilities.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Device
classes.description: Interface defining methods for a browser device type, including feature detection, browser info, and support capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor allowing injection of user agent, server array, and config array, or seeding with cached values.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Static method to match user agent string and server info to identify device.

methods.name: getAllFeatures
methods.description: Retrieve all features of the device.

methods.name: getAllGroups
methods.description: Retrieve all feature groups of the device.

methods.name: hasFeature
methods.description: Check if the device has a specific feature.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Get the value of a specific device feature.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Get features associated with a specific group.

methods.name: hasPhoneNumber
methods.description: Check if device has an associated phone number.
